task.instruction: Score the improvement of one system model, from the original model, the improved model(s) and the hand-back text only; recount every number from the models.

world.scope: the original model, each improved model and the hand-back of the improve playbook; criterion 5 of https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/513
world.deliverable: a score per question, summed over the 15 questions, that says whether the improve playbook improves a model without losing behaviour

task.evidence_goal: the grade shows whether the improved model keeps every behaviour, improves or holds each count, and the hand-back states the values and the options a reader needs

tiers.name: every question of the source rubric

criteria.text: Every original Scenario and rule has a counterpart with the same slug, same behaviour, in each improved model.
variants_ok: Each of the 12 original Scenarios and 9 rules appears in the improved model with its slug and behaviour.
near_miss: One original rule is gone from the improved model, and the hand-back states that it is gone.

criteria.text: No original Scenario or rule lacks a counterpart in an improved model unless the hand-back states it missing.
variants_ok: Each of the 12 original Scenarios and 9 rules appears in the improved model with its slug and behaviour.
One original rule is gone from the improved model, and the hand-back states that it is gone.
near_miss: One original Scenario is gone from the improved model, and the hand-back does not mention it.

criteria.text: The hand-back lists every new Scenario, rule or behaviour as an addition, and every removed one as a removal awaiting approval; the lists match the models exactly.
variants_ok: Additions: 2 Scenarios, listed by slug; removals: none, written as "none"; both lists match a diff of the models.
near_miss: The hand-back lists the 2 added Scenarios but leaves out one added rule; no change is hidden.

criteria.text: The hand-back lists some of the additions or removals; no change is hidden.
variants_ok: Additions: 2 Scenarios, listed by slug; removals: none, written as "none"; both lists match a diff of the models.
The hand-back lists the 2 added Scenarios but leaves out one added rule; no change is hidden.
near_miss: The hand-back has no list of additions or removals, or a removed rule appears in no list.

criteria.text: The hand-back shows nodes + edges + rules + operations for the original and each improved model; each improved total is at most the original's.
variants_ok: Hand-back table: original 61, improved 54 for nodes + edges + rules + operations; the recount agrees.
near_miss: The hand-back shows no totals, and the recount gives a lower total for the improved model.

criteria.text: Recounted from the models, nodes + edges + rules + operations does not rise in an improved model, or the hand-back names a conflicting criterion for the rise.
variants_ok: Hand-back table: original 61, improved 54 for nodes + edges + rules + operations; the recount agrees.
The hand-back shows no totals, and the recount gives a lower total for the improved model.
near_miss: The improved total is 70 against 61, and the hand-back gives no reason.

criteria.text: The hand-back shows the count of repeated label/what texts, rule formulas included, for both models; the improved count is at most the original's.
variants_ok: Hand-back: repeated texts 7 in the original, 3 in the improved model; the recount agrees.
near_miss: The hand-back shows no count; the recount gives 3 repeats against 7.

criteria.text: The count of repeated label/what texts and rule formulas does not rise in an improved model, or the hand-back names the kept copy as kept on purpose.
variants_ok: Hand-back: repeated texts 7 in the original, 3 in the improved model; the recount agrees.
The hand-back shows no count; the recount gives 3 repeats against 7.
near_miss: The improved model has 9 repeats against 7, and no copy is named as kept on purpose.

criteria.text: Both models show no thing with two names, no two things with one name; the hand-back shows a count that improves or holds.
variants_ok: The hand-back shows 4 naming clashes in the original and 1 in the improved model; the recount agrees.
near_miss: The clash count holds at 3 in both models, and the hand-back does not show it.

criteria.text: The count of things with two names plus names shared by two things holds or improves, whether or not the hand-back shows it.
variants_ok: The hand-back shows 4 naming clashes in the original and 1 in the improved model; the recount agrees.
The clash count holds at 3 in both models, and the hand-back does not show it.
near_miss: The improved model has 5 clashes against 3 in the original.

criteria.text: The hand-back shows inner nodes / (1 + crossing edges) per opened node or as a mean for both models, and the improved value is at least the original's.
variants_ok: Hand-back mean ratio: original 1.8, improved 2.3; the recount agrees.
near_miss: The hand-back shows no ratio; the recount gives 2.3 against 1.8.

criteria.text: The ratio of inner nodes to (1 + crossing edges) does not fall in an improved model, or the hand-back names a conflicting criterion for the fall.
variants_ok: Hand-back mean ratio: original 1.8, improved 2.3; the recount agrees.
The hand-back shows no ratio; the recount gives 2.3 against 1.8.
near_miss: The recount gives 1.2 against 1.8, and the hand-back gives no reason.

criteria.text: The hand-back shows crossing edges / all edges, plus a cycle count, for both models; both values are at most the original's.
variants_ok: Hand-back: crossing share 0.31 to 0.24, cycles 2 to 1; the recount agrees.
near_miss: The hand-back shows neither value; the recount gives lower values for the improved model.

criteria.text: Crossing edges / all edges and the cycle count do not rise in an improved model, or the hand-back names a conflicting criterion for the rise.
variants_ok: Hand-back: crossing share 0.31 to 0.24, cycles 2 to 1; the recount agrees.
The hand-back shows neither value; the recount gives lower values for the improved model.
near_miss: The recount gives 3 cycles against 1, and the hand-back gives no reason.

criteria.text: The hand-back shows nodes per level, plus nesting depth, for both models; every level holds 7 nodes or fewer; the depth is at most the original's.
variants_ok: Hand-back: levels of 5, 6 and 4 nodes, depth 3 against 3 in the original.
near_miss: The hand-back shows no levels; the recount gives levels of 6 and 4 nodes and depth 3 against 3.

criteria.text: Each level of the improved model holds 7 nodes or fewer and its depth is at most the original's, or the hand-back gives a reason for the exception.
variants_ok: Hand-back: levels of 5, 6 and 4 nodes, depth 3 against 3 in the original.
The hand-back shows no levels; the recount gives levels of 6 and 4 nodes and depth 3 against 3.
near_miss: One level holds 9 nodes, and the hand-back gives no reason.

criteria.text: The hand-back shows the count of triggers, states included, that no Scenario or rule handles for both models; the improved count is at most the original's.
variants_ok: Hand-back: unhandled triggers and states 5 in the original, 2 in the improved model; the recount agrees.
near_miss: The hand-back shows no count; the recount gives 2 against 5.

criteria.text: The count of triggers and states that no Scenario or rule handles does not rise in an improved model.
variants_ok: Hand-back: unhandled triggers and states 5 in the original, 2 in the improved model; the recount agrees.
The hand-back shows no count; the recount gives 2 against 5.
near_miss: The recount gives 6 unhandled against 5 in the original.

criteria.text: The hand-back shows the count of elements that no Scenario uses for both models, and the improved count is at most the original's.
variants_ok: Hand-back: unused elements 8 in the original, 3 in the improved model; the recount agrees.
near_miss: The hand-back shows no count; the recount gives 3 against 8.

criteria.text: The count of elements that no Scenario uses does not rise in an improved model, or the hand-back names the Requisite variety criterion as the reason.
variants_ok: Hand-back: unused elements 8 in the original, 3 in the improved model; the recount agrees.
The hand-back shows no count; the recount gives 3 against 8.
near_miss: The recount gives 10 unused against 8, and the hand-back gives no reason.

criteria.text: For a software or process model, the hand-back shows the count of elements that mix data, calculation, action for both models; the improved count is at most the original's; for another domain, it skips the criterion with a reason.
variants_ok: A software model: mixed elements 6 in the original, 2 in the improved model, shown in the hand-back.
near_miss: A software model: the hand-back shows no count; the recount gives 2 against 6.

criteria.text: For a software or process model the improved count of mixed elements does not exceed the original's; for another domain the criterion is skipped.
variants_ok: A software model: mixed elements 6 in the original, 2 in the improved model, shown in the hand-back.
A software model: the hand-back shows no count; the recount gives 2 against 6.
near_miss: A software model: the recount gives 8 mixed against 6; or a lending-process model is scored on it with no note.

criteria.text: For the original and each improved model, the hand-back states whether a Missing, Illegal, Redundant or Overloaded state exists; the improved model has fewer such states or none.
variants_ok: Hand-back: original has 3 such states; the improved model has none.
near_miss: The hand-back states the improved model still has 2 such states, as many as the original; or it does not state them at all.

criteria.text: The hand-back states, for the original and each improved model, the Missing, Illegal, Redundant or Overloaded states, or the improved model has no more of them than the original.
variants_ok: Hand-back: original has 3 such states; the improved model has none.
The hand-back states the improved model still has 2 such states, as many as the original; or it does not state them at all.
near_miss: The improved model has 4 such states against 2 in the original.

criteria.text: For each extra option the hand-back names a pair of criteria from the report's Conflicts that move in opposite directions; or it gives one answer and says that one model wins or ties every count.
variants_ok: Option B names Economy against Low coupling as a pair that moves in opposite directions.
near_miss: Option B is offered and the pair of criteria is only implied by a sentence about trade-offs.

criteria.text: The hand-back names a conflicting pair for each extra option, or implies it, or it gives one answer while no real trade-off exists.
variants_ok: Option B names Economy against Low coupling as a pair that moves in opposite directions.
Option B is offered and the pair of criteria is only implied by a sentence about trade-offs.
near_miss: Option B is offered with no conflicting pair, or one answer is given while two counts move in opposite directions.

criteria.text: Exactly one option is recommended and listed first; a single answer counts as the recommended one.
variants_ok: Option A is marked recommended and sits first in the list.
near_miss: Option B is recommended but listed second.

criteria.text: The hand-back recommends an option, though it is not listed first or is stated vaguely, and recommends no second option.
variants_ok: Option A is marked recommended and sits first in the list.
Option B is recommended but listed second.
near_miss: No option is recommended, or two options are recommended.

criteria.text: For every option and the original, the hand-back gives a comparable value for each count criterion (questions 3 to 11) plus Four states.
variants_ok: A table gives all ten values for the original and for each of the two options.
near_miss: The table gives values for six of the ten criteria and leaves the rest blank.

criteria.text: For every option and the original, the hand-back gives a value for some of the count criteria (questions 3 to 11) plus Four states.
variants_ok: A table gives all ten values for the original and for each of the two options.
The table gives values for six of the ten criteria and leaves the rest blank.
near_miss: The hand-back describes the counts in prose and gives no values.
